zachem: Kalibrovka p.1: model krivoy svedena s cepyu TOCHNO (model/fakt = 1.000000 na p10, mediane i p90, 22 718 sdelok), no VSEGO na 33 mintah i pri odnom tarife 0.0125. Esli u chasti krivyh tarif protokola ili sozdatelya drugoy, model s edinym tarifom na nih sovryot. Etot prohod beryot sluchaynuyu vyborku 30 000 sdelok krivyh (pump, raydium-launchpad, meteora-launchpad) po MNOGIM mintam iz tryoh chasov arhiva -- s sostoyaniem, summami i tarifom.
